# Traditional Alley

> Traditional Alley is a premier Nepali traditional and ethnic clothing brand based in Lalitpur/Kathmandu, Nepal, delivering authentic handcrafted cultural garments worldwide.

## About
Traditional Alley offers high-quality Nepali fashion, ethnic attire, and cultural clothing combining authentic Newari, Nepali Dhaka, and Himalayan textile heritage with contemporary designs.

- Website: https://traditionalalley.com.np
- Physical Store: Hattiban, Lalitpur, 44700, Bagmati, Nepal
- Contact Email: contact@traditionalalley.com.np
- Customer Support Phone: +977-9844594187
- Worldwide Shipping: Nepal, United States, Australia, United Kingdom, Canada, and global destinations.

## Core Collections
- [Women's Collection](https://traditionalalley.com.np/women): Authentic Nepali traditional dresses, lehengas, kurthas, sarees, and modern ethnic outfits.
- [Men's Collection](https://traditionalalley.com.np/men): Nepali Daura Suruwal, authentic Dhaka coats, ethnic blazers, and traditional menswear.
- [Kids' Collection](https://traditionalalley.com.np/kids): Cultural dresses and traditional festival outfits for children.
- [Dhaka & Cultural Wear](https://traditionalalley.com.np/collections/nepalidhaka): Authentic handwoven Nepali Dhaka items and topis.
- [Bridal & Party Lehenga](https://traditionalalley.com.np/collections/lehenga): Handcrafted Nepali wedding and reception lehengas.
- [Kurtha & Tunics](https://traditionalalley.com.np/collections/kurtha): Traditional and designer kurtha sets.
- [Ethnic Corsets](https://traditionalalley.com.np/collections/corsets): Modern Dhaka corsets and fusion evening wear.
